acceptance: Checker and parity design includes a prior-art decision for every added helper/dependency, using existing tooling where sufficient.

Fixture corpus includes valid directives/notices and invalid attached explanation, #/--/URL strings, sole-docstring bodies, dynamic __doc__, genuine parsed fixtures, embedded SQL, YAML blocks, JSX/heredocs/templates, unknown syntax and stale/missing-consumer exceptions.
Python comparison rejects all executable drift except exactly specified removal and empty-body repair; unrelated strings and controls are never normalized away.
Other declared languages/config classes have context-aware coverage, including CSS/HTML and notebook code; unsupported classes are visible failures rather than silently excluded.
Reporting, new-content blocking, completed-module ratchets and final strict mode all work against an immutable ownership/scope manifest.
Exceptions remain precise and provenance-bound; no blanket prefix, directory, file or 'fixture' exemptions; permanent interpreter requirements are not arbitrarily expired.
Checker limits are explicit: it does not prove simplicity, legal permission, arbitrary dynamic prose absence or benchmark equivalence.

description:
Own only the new bounded checker/parity helpers, their dedicated fixtures/tests and checker policy documentation; central CI/config edits belong to the shared infrastructure owner. Prior art: Python tokenize/AST, existing Windows AST scanner, installed TypeScript tooling, SQL compatibility inventory, repository schemas/loaders and existing exception records. Extend suitable tools before adding infrastructure or dependencies. Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Implement per-language exact directive/notice forms, allowed positions and consumed parameters. Handle strings, multiline text, heredocs, Make recipes, JSX/templates, YAML SQL blocks, optimizer hints and qgen directives. Authored literal docstrings are prohibited; inventory known runtime synthesis. Distinguish source comments from real parser test data and output protocols. Do not claim arbitrary dynamic product strings can be semantically classified by a syntax checker.

Python parity compares executable AST while ignoring locations and only first-statement docstrings/comments; allow pass solely for a newly empty sole-docstring class/function body. Type comments/pragmas have separate review. Do not ignore arbitrary string/control-flow differences. Use language-appropriate comparison elsewhere. Source-only SQL payload hashes remain byte-identical; expose dedicated payload changes separately.

Introduce legacy reporting, block new content and completed scopes, then enable whole-scope strict checks at closeout. Scope mutation/unknown syntax fails visibly. Stable exceptions use file+symbol/directive/payload identity, owner/consumer/removal trigger and exact text; detect unused or obsolete suppressions. Guard and required CI wiring land together through the shared owner. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.
